name: io.github.SmartMobileHouse/regon-mcp
title: REGON (Polish business register)
description: Look up Polish businesses in the GUS REGON register (BIR1) by NIP, REGON, or KRS.

environmentVariables.name: REGON_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: GUS BIR USER_KEY for live production data. Omit to use the public test key against the anonymized test database.

environmentVariables.name: REGON_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Which GUS environment to query: 'test' (default) or 'prod'. Use 'prod' with a real USER_KEY.
